```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
correlation <- read.csv("early_pathway_activity_long.csv")
pathways <- read.csv("early_pathway_filtered.csv")
```

```{r}
top_pathways <- pathways %>%
  group_by(database) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(spearman_r)), p_exact) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

top_pathways <- filter(top_pathways, spearman_r > 0.75 | spearman_r < -0.75)
```

```{r}
correlation_filtered <- filter(correlation, pathway %in% top_pathways$pathway)
```

```{r}
ggplot(correlation_filtered, aes(x= activity, y = persistence_score, color = database))+geom_point()+
geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4)+facet_wrap(~pathway, scales ="free")+theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(top_pathways, aes(x= spearman_r, y = reorder(pathway, spearman_r), fill = spearman_r))+geom_col()+theme_bw()+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu")
```
